extraction.events.csv: All 73 factual event/membership rows extracted from PDF pages 19–20, Appendix A.1. Empty early-event number for 30270-6341 retained; two pre-SGO rows receive victor-2023-1/4 identifiers. No deduplication or outcome relabeling.
extraction.comparisons.csv: Four reference comparisons transcribed from Table 7 (p. 10) and Appendix A.3 Listing 2 (p. 22). Human exposure/rates from Table 2 (p. 6); precision of Waymo miles from Listing 2. Published ratio/limits are audit targets, never calculation inputs.

limitations: The source is the versioned paper, not a fresh NHTSA download. Outcome and in-transport/impacted labels rely on the authors.
Human benchmark rates are supplied rounded estimates and include an underreporting adjustment for injury. Human state crash records and VMT are not rebuilt.
This is a historical city-level benchmark comparison, not a spatially reweighted comparison or randomized release experiment.
Primary result is San Francisco any-injury-reported; the other three rows are companion reproduction checks. No aggregate 7.1M-mile estimate is claimed.
interval_audit: Equation 2 uses alpha/2. Appendix A.3 Listing 1 first halves alpha for positive counts and then uses alpha/2, giving 0.0125 and 0.9875 at input alpha 0.05. Show both conventions; do not silently call Listing 1 a conventional 95% interval.
reference_tolerance: Counts must match exactly. Absolute ratio/endpoint tolerance <0.01 follows Appendix A.3 Listing 2; source inputs and references are rounded.
